from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

wb = load_workbook('sales_data.xlsx')
ws = wb.active

headers = {c.value: c.column for c in ws[1] if c.value is not None}
print('Headers:', headers)

def find(substrs, exclude=()):
    for name, col in headers.items():
        nl = str(name).lower()
        if all(s in nl for s in substrs) and not any(e in nl for e in exclude):
            return col
    return None

rev_col = find(['revenue']) or find(['sales'], exclude=['cost'])
prof_col = find(['profit'])
cost_col = find(['cost']) or find(['cogs'])

print('rev_col:', rev_col, 'prof_col:', prof_col, 'cost_col:', cost_col)

if rev_col is None:
    raise SystemExit('Could not locate a revenue/sales column')

r = get_column_letter(rev_col)

new_col = max(headers.values()) + 1
n = get_column_letter(new_col)
header = ws.cell(row=1, column=new_col, value='Profit Margin %')
header.font = Font(bold=True)

last_row = ws.max_row
for row in range(2, last_row + 1):
    cell = ws.cell(row=row, column=new_col)
    if prof_col is not None:
        p = get_column_letter(prof_col)
        cell.value = f'=IFERROR(IF({r}{row}=0,"",{p}{row}/{r}{row}),"")'
    else:
        c = get_column_letter(cost_col)
        cell.value = f'=IFERROR(IF({r}{row}=0,"",({r}{row}-{c}{row})/{r}{row}),"")'
    cell.number_format = '0.0%'

wb.save('sales_data.xlsx')
print('Saved. New column:', header.value, 'at column', n, 'rows 2..%d' % last_row)

import zipfile, re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
zin = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC)
names = zin.namelist()

M = '{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}'

shared = []
if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in names:
    root = ET.fromstring(zin.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
    for si in root.findall(M + 'si'):
        shared.append(''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter(M + 't')))

wbxml = zin.read('xl/workbook.xml').decode('utf-8')
relsxml = zin.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels').decode('utf-8')
relmap = dict(re.findall(r'<Relationship\b[^>]*Id="([^"]+)"[^>]*Target="([^"]+)"', relsxml))
rid = re.search(r'r:id="([^"]+)"', re.search(r'<sheet\b[^>]*>', wbxml).group(0)).group(1)
tgt = relmap[rid]
spath = tgt if tgt.startswith('xl/') else 'xl/' + tgt.lstrip('/')

errors = 0
for n in names:
    if n.startswith('xl/worksheets/') and n.endswith('.xml'):
        txt = zin.read(n).decode('utf-8')
        for e in ('#REF!', '#DIV/0!', '#VALUE!', '#N/A', '#NAME?', '#NULL!'):
            c = txt.count(e)
            if c:
                print('ERROR STRING', e, 'in', n, 'count', c)
                errors += c

sheet_text = zin.read(spath).decode('utf-8')
row_re = re.compile(r'<row\b[^>]*>.*?</row>|<row\b[^>]*/>', re.S)
cell_re = re.compile(r'<c\b[^>]*>.*?</c>|<c\b[^>]*/>', re.S)

target_col = None
samples = []
for m in row_re.finditer(sheet_text):
    row_xml = m.group(0)
    attrs = row_xml[:row_xml.find('>')]
    rn = int(re.search(r'\br="(\d+)"', attrs).group(1))
    cells = {}
    for cm in cell_re.finditer(row_xml):
        cxml = cm.group(0)
        cattrs = dict(re.findall(r'(\w+)\s*=\s*"([^"]*)"', cxml[:cxml.find('>')]))
        ref = cattrs.get('r')
        if not ref:
            continue
        ci = re.match(r'([A-Z]+)', ref).group(1)
        inner = cxml[cxml.find('>') + 1:]
        if cxml.rstrip().endswith('/>'):
            inner = ''
        if cattrs.get('t') == 's':
            v = re.search(r'<v>([^<]*)</v>', inner)
            val = shared[int(v.group(1))] if v else None
        elif cattrs.get('t') == 'inlineStr':
            val = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', inner)
        else:
            v = re.search(r'<v>([^<]*)</v>', inner)
            f = re.search(r'<f>(.*?)</f>', inner, re.S)
            val = v.group(1) if v else (('=' + f.group(1)) if f else None)
        cells[ci] = val
    if rn == 1:
        for ci, val in cells.items():
            if val and 'profit margin' in str(val).lower():
                target_col = ci
        print('headers:', cells)
    elif rn <= 7 and target_col and target_col in cells:
        samples.append((rn, cells.get(target_col)))
    if rn >= 7 and target_col and len(samples) >= 5:
        break

print('target column:', target_col)
print('samples:', samples)
print('total error strings:', errors)
zin.close()

import zipfile, re, os, sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
TMP = 'sales_data.tmp.xlsx'

M = '{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}'
RNS = '{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships}'
RNS2 = '{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}'

zin = zipfile.ZipFile(SRC)
names = zin.namelist()

rels_path = next((c for c in ('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels', '_rels/workbook.xml.rels') if c in names), None)
relmap = {}
for rel in ET.fromstring(zin.read(rels_path)):
    if rel.tag == RNS + 'Relationship':
        relmap[rel.attrib['Id']] = rel.attrib['Target']

wb_root = ET.fromstring(zin.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
rid = wb_root.find(M + 'sheets').find(M + 'sheet').attrib[RNS2 + 'id']
tgt = relmap[rid]
spath = tgt.lstrip('/')
if not spath.startswith('xl/'):
    spath = 'xl/' + spath

sheet_text = zin.read(spath).decode('utf-8')

row_re = re.compile(r'<row\b[^>]*>.*?</row>|<row\b[^>]*/>', re.S)
cell_re = re.compile(r'<c\b[^>]*>.*?</c>|<c\b[^>]*/>', re.S)


def cell_val(cxml):
    m = re.search(r'<v>([^<]*)</v>', cxml)
    if m:
        try:
            return float(m.group(1))
        except ValueError:
            return None
    return None


# collect revenue (E) and profit (G) per row
vals = {}
for m in row_re.finditer(sheet_text):
    row_xml = m.group(0)
    rmatch = re.search(r'\br="(\d+)"', row_xml[:row_xml.find('>')])
    if not rmatch:
        continue
    rn = int(rmatch.group(1))
    if rn < 2:
        continue
    row_vals = {}
    for cm in cell_re.finditer(row_xml):
        cxml = cm.group(0)
        refm = re.match(r'<c r="([A-Z]+)\d+"', cxml)
        if not refm:
            continue
        row_vals[refm.group(1)] = cxml
    e = row_vals.get('E')
    g = row_vals.get('G')
    rev = cell_val(e) if e else None
    prof = cell_val(g) if g else None
    if rev is not None and rev != 0 and prof is not None:
        vals[rn] = prof / rev
print('computed margins for rows:', sorted(vals))

new_sheet = []
pos = 0
updated = 0
for m in row_re.finditer(sheet_text):
    new_sheet.append(sheet_text[pos:m.start()])
    pos = m.end()
    row_xml = m.group(0)
    rmatch = re.search(r'\br="(\d+)"', row_xml[:row_xml.find('>')])
    rn = int(rmatch.group(1)) if rmatch else None
    if rn in vals:
        # add cached <v> to the H cell in this row
        def add_v(cm):
            cxml = cm.group(0)
            if re.match(r'<c r="H\d+"', cxml) and '<v>' not in cxml:
                nonlocal updated
                updated += 1
                return cxml[:-2] + '><v>%s</v></c>' % repr(vals[rn])
            return cxml
        row_xml = cell_re.sub(add_v, row_xml)
    new_sheet.append(row_xml)
new_sheet.append(sheet_text[pos:])
new_text = ''.join(new_sheet)
print('cached cells updated:', updated)

zout = zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, 'w')
for item in zin.infolist():
    if item.filename.endswith('/'):
        continue
    data = zin.read(item.filename)
    if item.filename == spath:
        data = new_text.encode('utf-8')
    elif item.filename == 'xl/calcChain.xml':
        continue
    zout.writestr(item, data)
zout.close()
zin.close()
os.replace(TMP, SRC)
print('OK: cached values written')
